what: avg_ctx of the FIRST assistant call (first message.usage in the transcript) for a sample of recording (записывающих) subagents, per the 'avg_ctx' field of the TOKEN_BUDGET.md methodology applied to a single call instead of a whole run.
whyFirstCallOnly: The whole-run avg_ctx in TOKEN_BUDGET.md averages over every call of a run, so it is dominated by later, compacted-in context. The quantity this Issue's acceptance criterion names is the context a fresh agent starts with, i.e. the first call only.

howRecordingWasIdentified.source: the opening ~300 characters of each subagent's first user-role message (the prompt the coordinator launched it with), read from ~/.claude/projects/C--gamedev-Dungeon-fortress/*/subagents/agent-*.jsonl
howRecordingWasIdentified.rule: classified as a review agent first if the opening text matches /read-only|review-агент|reviewer/i (checked first because some review prompts also say 'не исполнитель', which would otherwise false-match the recording rule on the substring 'исполнитель'); otherwise classified as recording if it matches /записывающ|implementation-агент|исполнитель/i; every file in the sample matched one of the two categories (0 unclassified)
howRecordingWasIdentified.limitation: text-pattern classification of the launch prompt, not a structural field. It groups together first-round executors and rework-circle executors (both change repository files per AGENTS.md's definition of recording work); it does not separate coordinator self-work sessions (main-session transcripts were not included at all, only */subagents/*.jsonl).

sample: all 57 recording subagent transcripts found on this machine (no date filter — the full available history, since the Issue asks for a sample and a median/spread, not a date-bounded baseline like TOKEN_BUDGET.md's)
command:
cd ~/.claude/projects/C--gamedev-Dungeon-fortress
> /tmp/rec_files.txt
for f in $(ls */subagents/*.jsonl); do
  head=$(jq -rs 'map(select(.type=="user" and (.message.content|type=="string"))) | (.[0].message.content // "")' "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -c 300)
  if echo "$head" | rg -qi 'read-only|review-агент|reviewer'; then
    : # review agent, skip
  elif echo "$head" | rg -qi 'записывающ|implementation-агент|исполнитель'; then
    echo "$f" >> /tmp/rec_files.txt
  fi
done
wc -l /tmp/rec_files.txt

> /tmp/first_ctx.txt
while IFS= read -r f; do
  v=$(jq -c 'select(.message.usage)' "$f" | head -1 | jq '((.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens//0)+(.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens//0)+(.message.usage.input_tokens//0))')
  [ -n "$v" ] && echo "$v" >> /tmp/first_ctx.txt
done < /tmp/rec_files.txt

jq -s '{n:length, min:min, max:max, mean:((add/length)|floor), median:(sort|.[(length/2|floor)]), p25:(sort|.[(length*0.25|floor)]), p75:(sort|.[(length*0.75|floor)])}' /tmp/first_ctx.txt

result.unit: tokens (cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + input_tokens of the first message.usage found in the transcript)

readingNote: avg_ctx of the first call already sits well under the acceptance criterion's implicit ceiling once you account for what actually drives it: the client auto-loads AGENTS.md (16 016 B per `git show HEAD:AGENTS.md | wc -c`) and take-task.ps1 prints AGENT_ENTRY.md (7 081 B) plus the Issue body (size varies per Issue) before the first tool call. Median first-call context of 29 617 tokens is consistent with that plus normal system/tool-schema overhead, not with the ~10-document, 900+ KB package the Issue describes as the historical brief — which would only show up later in the run, as an agent actually opens those files with Read. This measurement is 'before' in the sense the Issue asks for (median/spread of avg_ctx at call 1, current state); it is not a measurement of what a brief additionally instructed the agent to read afterward.
afterMeasurement: Not taken. No runs against the rewritten AGENT_ENTRY.md / take-task.ps1 exist yet at measurement time (this PR is that rewrite). Repeat with the same command once a batch of recording subagents has run under the new entry package; compare the same n/median/p25/p75 fields.
